archetypeNotes: Lifegain control into combo. Contains a complete Exquisite Blood + Sanguine Bond pair, plus Aetherflux Reservoir and Test of Endurance / Felidar Sovereign alt-wins. Dense prison and tax effects.
curatorRationale: High-power non-cEDH. Supplies stax/control and a highly-interactive-but-slower-to-close shape. DUPLICATE COMMANDER with the incoherent-slot deck: retaining both is intentional, giving a same-commander / different-99 methodological contrast. Possible confound recorded: a rater may anchor the two against each other, or judge by commander reputation rather than construction. Deliberately NOT an anchor candidate for that reason.
